description: This object defines the metadata for your plugin. This information is used to create local store entry.

description.description: Give your plugin a nice description!

publisher.description: Provide the company/develper/publisher name as vetted an authorized by UD.

executableName.description: The name of your executable such as plugin.py

installScript.description: The installation script. If none, default (install.sh) will be used.

documentationLink.description: Link to the documentation for this plugin

licenseLink.description: Link to the license for this plugin

shortPoll.description: Initial short poll interval in seconds

longPoll.description: Initial long poll interval in seconds

profileVersion.description: The Polyglot profile version. Such as 3.0.0 (default)

initialLogLevel.description: The log level when the plugin starts

status.description: What's should be or is the status of this plugin in the store

enableOAUTH2.description: Enable the plugin to handle OAUTH 2 authentication. If you enabled this feature, you must also provide OAuth Configuration parameters on the store entry (not safe in this file)

worksOnPolisy.description: Whether or not this plugin works on Polisy

worksOnEisy.description: Whether or not this plugin works on Polisy

requiresIoXAccess.description: Whether or not this plugin can directly communiate with IoX. If you choose true, the customer must explicitly accept

enableFileUpload.description: Whether or not this plugin can directly communiate with IoX. If you choose true, the customer must explicitly accept

enableDiscovery.description: Whether or not the plugin requires mdns discovery services

customParams.description: A JSON formatted string with a list of custom parameters that can be set by customer. Do NOT include anything that requires security/privacy. For those, set them directly in the store.

oauthParms.description: A JSON formatted string for OAuth configuration. Do NOT include unless PUBLICLY available information. For private/security configuration. set them directly in the store

hardwareConfig.description: Filename that includes instructions for setting up hardware permission. See sample_hw.conf file in your project directory.

customData.description: Any free form text/data you need in your plugin. Do NOT include anything that requires privacy/security

requirements.description: pip packages to be installed. udi_interface and ioxplugin are installed by default.

nodesAreStatic.description: Whehter or not nodes are statically created from the node definitions or the protocol handler dynamically creates them after discovery.

version.description: The version that's displayed to the user and then installed in iox
